metrics.definition: 按 source_type 统计条数与占比（枚举全集以代码 governance.source_tiers 为准）
固定种子抽 5 张事件卡，断言对回原文。脚本输出机械层证据；语义判定（原文有/无/不全）见报告

samples.title: AI's Biggest Winners Are Selling Off, and ETFs Are Behaving Strangely
samples.card_fact_summary: Yahoo Finance QQQ Headlines于2026年7月29日发布一篇报道，标题为"AI's Biggest Winners Are Selling Off, and ETFs Are Behaving Strangely"。无全文正文可用。
samples.card_interpretation: 仅据标题推测，该报道描述了AI大赢家股的抛售现象以及相关ETF出现"反常"表现。由于缺乏正文，无法判断抛售规模、涉及的个股范围以及ETF反常行为的具体形式（如折溢价异常、成交量骤变或资金流向逆转等）。标题本身暗示资金可能从前期领涨的AI标的中撤出，若ETF行为确实异常，可能反映被动资金或散户情绪出现拐点。但全文缺失限制了推断的置信度。

samples.title: Satellite maker K2 Space secures $6.8 billion valuation in new funding round
samples.card_fact_summary: 据Yahoo Finance M7 Headlines报道，卫星制造商K2 Space在一轮新融资中获得68亿美元估值。材料仅提供标题，无正文摘录。
samples.card_interpretation: 与判断对象关联不足。K2 Space为未上市私营企业，非纳斯达克100成份股，其融资事件对NDX指数走势缺乏直接传导路径。

samples.title: Meta stock poised for a new losing streak: Earnings call takeaways
samples.card_fact_summary: Yahoo Finance M7 Headlines 于2026年7月30日报道了一篇题为'Meta stock poised for a new losing streak: Earnings call takeaways'的文章，指出Meta股票可能面临新一轮下跌，内容涉及财报电话会议要点。无完整正文可用。
samples.card_interpretation: 据该媒体报道，Meta在最近一次财报电话会议后可能面临股价持续下跌压力。由于仅有标题而无正文，具体财报要点不明，但标题基调偏负面。Meta作为M7核心成分股及纳指100重要权重股，若其股价持续走弱，可能对指数层面产生拖累。该报道的负面倾向与当前市场对M7盈利可持续性的关注相呼应。

samples.title: Exchange-Traded Funds, Equity Futures Higher Pre-Bell Thursday Amid Tech Earnings
samples.card_fact_summary: Yahoo Finance QQQ Headlines于2026年7月30日盘前报道，交易所交易基金（ETFs）和股票期指在科技公司财报季期间走高。全文内容不可用，仅标题可供分析。
samples.card_interpretation: 该报道标题显示盘前市场在科技财报背景下表现积极，可能暗示部分科技公司财报结果或市场对科技板块的预期偏向正面。但由于全文不可用，无法获知具体哪些科技股财报推动上涨、涨跌幅大小以及报道的详细分析逻辑，解读力度有限。盘前交易流动性通常较低，价格信号对正式开盘的预示作用存在不确定性。

samples.title: $19.6 Billion: The Microsoft Earnings Number That Matters Most
samples.raw_text_excerpt: $19.6 Billion: The Microsoft Earnings Number That Matters Most | The Motley Fool Accessibility Menu ▲ S&P 500 + ---% | ▲ Stock Advisor + ---% Join The Motley Fool Search for a company Accessibility ... Help Microsoft ( MSFT +15.09% ) stock is up 13% today on the strength of quarterly earnings that s
samples.card_fact_summary: Microsoft (MSFT) stock rose approximately 13% on quarterly earnings. Revenue increased 18% YoY; cloud computing revenue exceeded $100B for the first time. The article highlights $19.6B in free cash flow despite massive AI infrastructure CapEx. Fiscal Q4 2026 (ended June 30): Revenue $90B (vs $76.4B), Net income $35.76B (+31%), EPS $4.81 (vs $3.86). Full FY2026: Revenue $331.8B (+18%), Net income $133.7B (+31%), EPS $17.95 (vs $13.64). Segment YoY growth rates: Microsoft Cloud Revenue +27%, Commercial Remaining Performance Obligation +84%, M365 Commercial Cloud +14%, Consumer Cloud +24%, LinkedIn +12%, Dynamics 365 +13%, Azure and Other Cloud Services +43%, Search Advertising (ex-TAC) +10%. Windows OEM and Devices -7%, Xbox Content and Services -10%. CEO Satya Nadella: 'We are advancing the frontier on the cost-to-outcome curve...' Azure revenue surpassed $100B for the first time; M365 Copilot reached over 30M paid seats.
samples.card_interpretation: MSFT's earnings report shows strong top-line growth, margin expansion, and—critically—$19.6B in free cash flow despite elevated AI capex. The article contrasts this with Tesla and Alphabet, which it says 'faltered' after their reports. For NDX, MSFT as the largest or near-largest index weight posting such cash-generating AI results supports the view that mega-cap AI spending is productive rather than value-destructive. However, the article's framing includes the author's opinion ('I believe'), and index-level implications require confirmation that other M7 components show similar FCF dynamics. This single data point cannot prove a broad trend but offers evidence consistent with the '过度反应/估值修复' narrative.
